payload.text: A disk of constant moment of inertia I experiences torque τ(t)=τ₀e^{-t/T} from rest.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Design a feasible measurement that tests the governing relation; identify the independent variable, dependent variable, and one control.

criteria.description: Design measures the disk's angular velocity ω at successive times t as it spins up under the decaying torque; independent variable is elapsed time t, dependent variable is measured angular velocity ω, and the disk's moment of inertia I (same disk) must be held constant across trials.
required_evidence: control: moment of inertia I held constant
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show independent variable: elapsed time t; dependent variable: angular velocity ω; control: moment of inertia I held constant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Explain how the predicted approach to a limiting angular velocity ω_max=τ₀T/I, and the assumption that frictional torque at the bearing is negligible, supports your proposed measurement design.

criteria.description: Explain how the predicted approach to a limiting angular velocity ω_max=τ₀T/I, and the assumption that frictional torque at the bearing is negligible, supports your proposed measurement design.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show ω approaches limiting value τ₀T/I; negligible frictional torque.

accessibility.accommodation_notes: Text and symbolic notation are fully described.
